name: generate_image
description: Generate a raster image from a text prompt and place it directly in an editable Design, FigJam, or Slides file. If no editable file exists, call create_new_file first. Width and height guide the aspect ratio; the model chooses a supported output size, so the image pixel dimensions may differ from the requested values. Omit nodeId to create a new image-filled frame, or provide nodeId to replace an existing image fill without resizing it. Returns fileKey, nodeId, model, image metadata (including width, height, and image.url for downloading the full-resolution image), and curl instructions, plus an inline thumbnail preview. **This is a paid feature — each call consumes Figma AI credits against the destination file's plan (different models have different per-call costs).**

sessionId.description: After create_session succeeds, pass its exact returned UUID here on every file-tool call for this task, even when fileKey differs.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate.

model.description: Image model to use. One of: gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image, gpt-image-2.5-flare, gpt-image-2.5-sunburst, gemini-3.1-flash-image. Defaults to gpt-image-2.5-flare.

width.description: Requested width in pixels. Together with height, selects the closest supported aspect ratio; actual image width may differ. Default: 1024; max: 2048.

height.description: Requested height in pixels. Together with width, selects the closest supported aspect ratio; actual image height may differ. Default: 1024; max: 2048.

fileKey.description: The key of the Figma file to use. If the URL is provided, extract the file key from the URL. The given URL must be in the format https://figma.com/design/:fileKey/:fileName?node-id=:int1-:int2. The extracted fileKey would be `:fileKey`.

nodeId.description: Existing node (eg: "123:456" or "123-456") whose image fill should be replaced without resizing it; nested instance IDs ("I123:456;789:012") are unsupported. Omit to create a new frame.
